en: Phew, it's finally done!
No other witch in the world will have a home as wonderful as this!
For how long, though?
Huh?
It's long past time for a tea party.
Ah, you're right...
Well, I'm sure the other witches will come and invite me when it's time.
The Garden might come to ruin the longer we wait...
My home!!
Looks like the apocalypse is already coming.
My precious home... I worked so hard on it...
Why not just leave it? It looks like a nice ornament.
But then my home will get even more ruined. The rest of the garden, too!
At least you won't have to go through the bother of keeping everything clean anymore.
This isn't the time for jokes!
What are you going to do, then?
What else? Gather the other witches for a tea party.
There's no other way to put Nahatra to sleep.
Hmm, I guess.
I'll be back soon!
The nightmares have already spread this far...
The others have completely forgotten about the tea party, haven't they?
Fiena...? Are you there...?
She’s definitely passed out somewhere, clearly intoxicated by the scent of the flowers.
I'd better hurry, it's not good to smell the flowers here for long.
Pfft! Bwahahaha!!...HIC!!
Fiena...?
Fiena! Wake up! We need to do a tea party! It's already too late!
Red...! And yellow...? Morel mushrooms! Poppies! A-And...!
Yes! Let's dance! Dance for a wonderful dream...
Looks like I'll need to smack some sense into her.
Ouch! My head! What's wrong with you!?
Worked like a charm.
Sil! What a pleasure to see you! Wanna share a cup of tea?
Fiena! What have you been doing all this time?!
The garden is covered in nightmares!
Nightmares...? Eek! You're right! How did this happen?
Oh goodness, my flower garden is going to be ruined!
Will you stay with me until then, Sil? I've been so lonely...
Sorry, I'm too busy. I need to find the other witches for the tea party!
Oh right! Tea party...
Come join us when you're ready, got it?
Sure... After one more cup of tea.
Fiena!
All right, all right!
See you later!
I really hope she doesn't forget...
We need Abigail's pumpkin pie for the tea party.
But last time I set foot on her field, she came swinging at me with her scythe.
It's such a pain that she's always stuck on her farm.
If only we could meet more often...
Abigail...?
You remember me, right? I know we don't see each other often, but...
Trespasser...!!!
Get off my land!!!
Here we go again...
Phew... Have you calmed down now?
Don't say too much at once...
You're aware the nightmares are spreading through the garden, right?
...They trespassed on my farm.
So I got angry.
And tried to get rid of them all.
But I couldn't.
Dealing with nightmares isn't as simple as pruning a tree.
They won't stop until the entire garden is ruined.
Only a tea party can stop that from happening. That's the contract we signed, remember?
...That does sound familiar...
Familiar...?! Do you really care about anything except your farm?
How often do you even step outside this field?
Quit nagging.
Ugh, fine... You're coming to the tea party though, right?
...Yes.
See you later, then. I need to go gather the others!
I know I need to gather everyone for the tea party, but...
I really don't want to go in there.
Hooray!
Welcome! ☆
Come on in!
Curses, totems, mountain sacrifices... and forbidden spells!
What can we do for you?
Nothing.
Just get ready for the tea party.
Before Nahatra wakes up.
A-Ah, you're here about the tea party?
Heh...
Hmm, but how should I put this...?
We hate to do favors for free.
...You know what happens if we don't hold this tea party.
Aha, you're worried about the garden being destroyed?
The living are always worrying about things dying, Berry.
Now, now, don't be judgmental, Rims.
For once, Sil is going give us what we want.
You didn't come here without expecting this, did you. Sil?
What you want... You mean...?
Flesh and blood, of course!
Mwahahahahaha!
This really is the worst place in the whole garden...
Welcome back! You took your time...
We were worried you'd collapsed on the way!
Yes, we would hate for you to get any cuts and bruises on your precious flesh...
Do you girls even care about the tea party?
Oh, yes. The tea party is extremely important.
We just think you're more important. Don't you agree?
Now, if you kindly hand over your flesh, we'll take part in as many tea parties as you'd like. ☆
I'm sorry, but I'll have to decline.
Then there's nothing else for it...
We'll just have to take your flesh by force!
You wicked witches...! You're going to do as you're told now.
It appears we failed again, Berry.
Right, Rims. If only Sil wasn't such a talented witch.
Then that delectable flesh would be all ours...
Hehehehehe!
You can't be so obsessed with other people's flesh and blood.
Not just anyone's.
Only yours, hehehe!
Don't be so selfish, Sil! Can't you just tear off a limb or two for us? It's not like it'll kill you.
No, it will! I've died more times than I care to count. All because I believed others when they said they'd cooperate.
But why are YOU so obsessed with this tea party?
Does the garden's destruction scare you so much?
Because she's obsessed with being alive. The living are always babbling on about such things.
Sure, whatever works for you, as long as you take part in the tea party.
Oh ♡  Sil, you're always so mean to us! But I suppose that's part of your charm!
Well, if Sil insists, I guess we have no choice, Berry.
See you at the tea party, Sil!
I wish that just once they'd do what I ask the first time around.
The closer I get to the tea party area, the stronger the nightmare energy gets.
I promised Chloe last time that I wouldn't be late again... And the time before that...
...Chloe? Are you here?
Why's it so quiet?
Is she angry...?
...I'm warning you!
If you're late preparing the tea party next time too, there won't be one.
Yep, she's definitely going to be angry with me.
Well, I'm sure we'll work it out...
How bold of you to show your face.
What brings you here?
You've already missed the deadline.
You know how unruly others can be, Chloe.
Gathering multiple witches in one place is like herding cats.
So does that make me not a witch because I'm here protecting this place?
Late again. Must you always wait until the realm begins collapsing to start doing anything?
*gulping*
I've been up all night fending off nightmares while you've been fooling around...
Do you have any idea how many times I died in that time?!
...S-Six— No, seven!
Wrong!
It was countless times!
And now it's your turn to suffer the pain I did!
*panting*
I don't care what you say, I'm not holding another tea party!
If you lot are the kind of witches living here, it would be better to just let the garden die!
Please, listen to me, Chloe.
I met all the other witches before coming.
They said they'd prepare and meet me here.
...Maybe...
Maybe?
...The point is—! All the other witches will be here, but without you, we can't have the tea party.
Are you okay with it being your fault the tea party failed?
...Excuse me?
My fault?!
H-How can you say something so shameless!?
But if you're the only one refusing to take part, who else is to blame?
Can you live with that?
Hmph...
I won't be tricked so easily.
How many times have you tried that now?
I'll go calm Nahatra down so we can at least get the tea party started.
...Hmph, do as you like.
If you can, that is.
The whole place is already crawling with nightmares anyway.
You won't last five minutes.
I knew I could rely on you.
I never said I'd be taking part!
It's been a while, Nahatra.
Not since last year's tea party, right?
The nightmares must have disturbed her rest badly.
Don't worry. I'll help you get right back to sleep.
It's time for a tea party, Nahatra.
I thought you said this place was falling apart? It looks just fine!
This is why I can't stand the living!
Let's get this over and done with so I can get back to my farm.
I'm heeeeere!
Phew, when was the last we all met up clear-headed? Hic!
This is how you extended the life of the garden? Pah!
I knew you'd come. Thank you, Chloe.
Hmph!
Shall we begin?
With a knot woven by the Thread Witch.
With dewdrops brewed by the Flower Witch.
With soil sprinkled by the Pumpkin Witch.
With flesh devoured by the Blood Witch.
With a flame lit by the Wax Witch.
In the name of all witches, we will now host our tea party.
Phew, we just about made it. Again.
We always get along so well.
We've prepared lots of presents, so enjoy!
Do you like them?
I knew you would!
It's a gift! I put my whole heart and soul into it, hehehe!
It all worked out, but is it really so hard to be on time for a change?
Why do you always have to leave it to the last second??
I'm really getting fed up with having to wait until the garden is on the verge of destruction to have a tea party every time.
I'd rather just let it all fall to ruin and be done with it.
That's a bit much...
I like living here in the garden.
Then come to the tea party on time!!
That was one of the main rules of our contract!
Always going on about rules and contracts... *yawning*
You're such a weirdo, Chloe.
Since when do witches require rules and order to live?
Maybe if you did care, we wouldn't always end up in such trouble.
S-Sil is the one in charge of invites! Blame her for taking so long!
No, I'm not!
It's just that nobody else ever bothers, so I have no choice in the end!
Fiiiine! Leave it all to me next time, ladies!
For the next— HIC! ...next tea party!
I'll come collect you all!
Even if it's Sil's job, it's unfair to make her do it every time, hehe!
It's not my job!
I... I promise... I promise I'll stay awake! HIC!
I won't drink anything until the next tea party! Not even water!!
I'm not convinced...
Me neither.
Do you think we can rely on her, Chloe?
As long as the tea party happens on time, I don't care.
Pfft! I'll stop by your place first, Sil! Make sure you're waiting for me!
I'm sure I'll be left waiting, all right...
Can I go home now?
You hear that, Berry?
What's the rush? How often are we all together like this? Let's have some more fun first!
Long, long ago, witches were born from a boundless darkness.
They knew neither why they were born, nor what their purpose was.
Then, one day, the Dream Witch appeared in their world.
This Dream Witch was able to create a world of her own design.
Curious, the other witches asked if they could join her in her world.
The Dream Witch graciously granted them entrance
and it became known as the Garden.
Oh no...
Better luck next time!
That's more like it! You're improving!
There's no need to rush.
You'll do better next time.
...Maybe.
There's nothing worse than watching scissors cut through thin air.
Hmm...
I'll pretend I didn't see that one.
Unfortunately, this is where this story ends.
Try not to be discouraged.
Very few people open the book straight to the right page.
I think you're getting the hang of it.
...That sounds familiar.
I'll lend you a paw if you're in trouble.
Oh, you don't need my help?
...Fine.
If you enjoy dying, it's not my place to interfere...
But aren't you doing it too often?
You were done before my tea even cooled down.
That has to be a new record.
Did you trip? Or get distracted?
Whatever it was, I'll chalk it down as a minor mishap.
Do you like lying on the floor or something?
I'm deeply disappointed...
Sorry, I dozed off.
Where did we get to?
Maybe I should start accepting bets on how far you'll get.
I'll have to caption this one...
An admirable effort.
Pfft! Look at your face!
I'll have to frame this one.
There's no need to physically experience every last danger in the garden...
You're so quick, and agile, and... precise...
...When it comes to falling down.
Oof, that one hurt to watch.
...So I'll keep on only watching,
No! Sil!!
...Sorry, I got carried away.
You'll have to watch your step better.
Or... maybe look up more.
And the witches lived happily ever after in the boundless darkness...
Just kidding!
An optimistic cat like me doesn't even blink when their companion falls down.
I'd heard it was human nature to repeat the same mistakes over and over.
Since you seem unaware, can I offer some advice?
May I suggest dodging enemy attacks?
I'm always rooting for you!
But... Can you wake me up when you're finally done?
Aww, no!
You were so close that time!
Get your act together. The story's dragging out too long.
If it's any consolation, that was a cooler death than the last one.
I'll annotate this page if you want.
"Sil dies here."
Sil didn't care much about dying.
She just wanted to move on to the next part of the story.
Oh, how sad... Genuinely.
Ah well, there's always next time.
You need to focus a little harder.
Try doing some stretches...
...and then we can give this another try.
Oh well......
You're not going to fill this entire book with Sil's face, are you?
This must be the death number... {$cnt1}? No, {$cnt2}!
